title: 第115章 长青仙法，大道至简
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

蜀山，锁妖塔。

这里并非困锁妖魔的地方，而是一座剑冢。

无数断裂的古剑，插在山壁之上，散发着凌厉的剑气。

蜀山剑派，自封神之后，传承断绝，只能靠着这些古剑上残留的剑意，来参悟剑道，早已不复当年的辉煌。

当云逍在淮南，看到顾长青一指断江，一念碎月的时候，他就已经通过秘法，将消息传回了宗门。

此刻，整个蜀山剑派，所有还活着的剑修，都聚集在剑冢之前，看着水镜中的画面，一个个都激动得浑身发抖，手中的剑，都在不停地嗡鸣。

“好强的剑意！不，那已经不是剑意了！那是道！是言出法随的大道！”

一个独臂老者，抚摸着身旁的一柄断剑，眼中充满了狂热。

“我蜀山剑修，求的便是一剑破万法！可这天道不公，灵气断绝，我等连御剑飞行都难以做到，何谈破法？”

“如今，顾祖师撕开了这天！为我等剑修，重新开辟了一条通天之路！”

“我感觉到了！我感觉到了！我手中的剑，它在渴望！它在渴望去到那位祖师的身边！”

所有的蜀山弟子，都将目光投向了剑冢最上方，那个盘膝而坐的白发老者。

那是蜀山当代唯一的剑仙，也是他们的掌门。

老者缓缓地睁开眼睛，他的眼中，没有瞳孔，只有两道浓缩到极致的剑光。

“我蜀山……沉寂得太久了。”

他的声音，如同剑鸣，清越而又锋利。

“三千年前，我蜀山先辈，曾追随长青仙宗的祖师，与天一战。虽败，但剑心未死。”

“三千年后，长青再出世，我蜀山，岂能落于人后？”

他缓缓地站起身，伸手一招。

插在剑冢最高处，那柄锈迹斑斑，看起来平平无奇的古剑，突然发出一声震天龙吟，化作一道流光，飞入他的手中。

“所有蜀山弟子听令！”

“执剑，随我……再战九天！”

类似的场景，在华夏，乃至世界各地的角落，不断上演。

那些曾经因为末法时代而隐世不出，在历史长河中被渐渐遗忘的古老宗门，修行世家，在这一天，纷纷被惊醒。

他们或为长生，或为大道，或为传承。

但他们的目标，在这一刻，都出奇的一致。

那就是——淮南！

那就是——顾长青！

一时间，华夏大地上空，流光四起，剑气纵横。

无数道强大的气息，从沉睡中复苏，向着同一个方向汇聚而去。

一场由顾长青亲手掀起的，席卷整个修行界的巨大浪潮，正式拉开了序幕。

而这一切的始作俑者，顾长青，只是安静地悬浮在空中，看着下方那如同潮水般用来的人道气运，又看了一眼天边那些正在向这里赶来的流光，脸上没什么表情。

一切，都在他的计划之中。

他转头看向身旁的嬴政。

“你看，这就是‘人’的力量。”

“星星之火，可以燎原。”

嬴政看着下方那一张张激动而狂热的脸，看着那一道道从四面八方赶来的修行者的身影，心中充满了震撼。

他第一次，如此直观地感受到了国师口中那股名为“人道”的洪流，是何等的波澜壮阔。

“国师，朕……受教了。”

嬴政再一次，发自内心地躬身行礼。

他知道，从今天起，这个世界，将彻底不一样了。

而他，以及他的仙秦，将在这场变革中，扮演一个至关重要的角色。

他看着顾长青，眼神中的战意，再次被点燃。

只不过这一次，他的战意中，少了一丝个人的狂妄，多了一份为了整个“人族”而战的沉重和决然。

他将目光投向了749局的指挥中心，看着那些为了维持秩序而忙碌奔波的凡人，心中第一次，对他们产生了一丝认同感。

或许，国师说的是对的。

永远，不要小看凡人。

就在华夏官方和民间都因为这场史无前例的巨变而沸腾之时，一支支由古代修行者组成的队伍，也陆续抵达了淮南禁区的边缘。

他们有的驾驭着飞剑，有的乘坐着古老的法舟，有的甚至直接肉身飞行，带着一股与现代社会格格不入的古朴气息。

“站住！前方是军事禁区，未经允许，不得入内！”

负责外围警戒的士兵，看到这些“奇装异服”的人，立刻紧张地举起了枪，大声警告。

然而，这些刚刚从深山老林里出来的隐世宗门之人，哪里会把凡人士兵放在眼里。

“区区凡人，也敢拦我去路？滚开！”

一个来自终南山守墓人一脉的长老，脾气火爆，他只是冷哼一声，一股无形的气浪就将那几个士兵推开了好几米远。

这些士兵虽然经过强化训练，但在真正的修行者面前，还是不够看。

“你们……”

士兵们还想说些什么，但更多的流光从天而降。

蜀山剑派的弟子，个个背着长剑，眼神锋利。

方丈仙岛的道士，手持拂尘，仙风道骨。

还有一些叫不出名字的小门小派，也都拿出了自己压箱底的行头，生怕被人看轻了。

他们聚集在一起，足有数百人之多，每一个人的身上，都散发着强大的气息。

这股力量，足以轻易地摧毁一支现代化的军队。

守军的负责人，一位上校军官，看着眼前这群仿佛从神话里走出来的人，额头上冷汗直流，但他依旧没有退缩，只是通过对讲机向上级紧急求援。

“李寒山道长，云逍掌门，外面……外面来了一大群身份不明的修行者，他们想要强行闯入禁区！”

很快，李寒山和云逍等人就得到了消息。

他们对视一眼，都看到了对方眼中的凝重。

“走，去看看。”

李寒山作为昆仑掌门，又是第一个向顾长青宣誓效忠的人，此刻自然而然地担起了“维稳”的责任。

当李寒山和云逍等人出现在禁区边缘时，那些隐世宗门的修士，立刻将目光投了过来。

“哦？总算来了几个像样点的了。”

终南山的那位长老，上下打量了一下李寒山，眼神中带着一丝轻蔑。

“看你的服饰，是昆仑派的？哼，当年封神之战，你们昆仑的前辈阐教十二金仙，何等威风。怎么到了你们这一代，就变得如此孱弱？连个金丹期都没有，真是丢人现眼。”

李寒山听到这话，脸色一沉。

他们昆仑派虽然也算名门大派，但跟这些从上古传承下来的隐世宗门比起来，底蕴确实差了不少。

尤其是对方一开口就提到了封神之战，那股子老前辈的派头，压得他有些喘不过气。

“这位前辈是？”李寒山还是耐着性子，拱手问道。

Shushan, Demon Locking Tower.

This is not a place where demons are trapped, but a sword tomb.

Countless broken ancient swords were stuck on the mountain wall, exuding sharp sword energy.

The Shushan Sword Sect, after becoming a god, lost its inheritance and could only rely on the remaining sword intent on these ancient swords to understand the art of swordsmanship. It has long lost its former glory.

When Yun Xiao was in Huainan and saw Gu Changqing cut off the river with his finger and thought of the moon, he had already passed the news back to the sect through a secret method.

At this moment, the entire Shushan Sword Sect and all the surviving sword cultivators gathered in front of the sword tomb. Looking at the scene in the water mirror, they were all trembling with excitement, and the swords in their hands kept buzzing.

"Such a strong sword intention! No, that is no longer sword intention! It is the Tao! It is the great way to follow the rules!"

A one-armed old man was stroking a broken sword beside him, his eyes full of enthusiasm.

"What I, the Shushan Sword Cultivator, want is to break all laws with one sword! But the way of heaven is unfair and the spiritual energy is cut off. We can't even fly with a sword, so how can we talk about breaking laws?"

"Now, Patriarch Gu has torn the sky apart! He has opened up a new path to the sky for sword cultivators like us!"

"I feel it! I feel it! The sword in my hand is longing! It is longing to go to the Patriarch!"

All Shushan disciples turned their attention to the white-haired old man sitting cross-legged at the top of the sword tomb.

That is the only contemporary Sword Immortal in Shushan and also their leader.

The old man slowly opened his eyes. In his eyes, there were no pupils, only two extremely condensed sword lights.

"My Shushan...has been silent for too long."

His voice was like the sound of a sword, clear and sharp.

"Three thousand years ago, my ancestor from Shushan followed the ancestor of the Evergreen Immortal Sect and fought against the sky. Although he was defeated, the sword's heart was not dead."

"Three thousand years later, Changqing will be born again. How can I, Shushan, lag behind others?"

He stood up slowly and stretched out his hand.

Inserted at the highest point of the sword tomb, the rusty, ordinary-looking ancient sword suddenly let out a thunderous roar, turned into a stream of light, and flew into his hand.

"All Shushan disciples obey orders!"

"Hold the sword, follow me... fight for nine more days!"

Similar scenes continue to be staged in corners of China and even around the world.

Those ancient sects and practicing families that had been hidden from the world because of the Age of Ending Dharma, and were gradually forgotten in the long river of history, were awakened one after another on this day.

They are either for immortality, the great road, or inheritance.

But their goals, at this moment, are surprisingly consistent.

That is - Huainan!

That is - Gu Changqing!

For a time, in the sky above the land of China, streams of light appeared in all directions, and sword auras spread across the sky.

Countless powerful auras emerged from their slumber and converged in the same direction.

A huge wave swept across the entire spiritual world, set off by Gu Changqing himself, officially kicked off.

And the initiator of all this, Gu Changqing, was just floating quietly in the air, looking at the human luck below that was flowing like a tide, and then glanced at the streams of light on the horizon that were coming here, with no expression on his face.

Everything is according to his plan.

He turned to look at Ying Zheng beside him.

"You see, this is the power of 'people'."

"A single spark can start a prairie fire."

Ying Zheng looked at the excited and fanatical faces below and the figures of practitioners coming from all directions, and his heart was filled with shock.

For the first time, he so intuitively felt how majestic the torrent called "humanity" in the mouth of the Imperial Master was.

"National Master, I...have received instruction."

Ying Zheng once again bowed and saluted from the bottom of his heart.

He knew that from today on, the world would be completely different.

And he, and his Xian Qin, will play a vital role in this change.

He looked at Gu Changqing, and the fighting spirit in his eyes was ignited again.

Only this time, his fighting spirit lacked a trace of personal arrogance, and had more of a heavy and decisive feeling of fighting for the entire "human race".

He set his sights on the command center of Bureau 749 and looked at the mortals who were busy running to maintain order. For the first time, he felt a sense of identification with them.

Perhaps, what the Imperial Master said is right.

Never underestimate mortals.

Just when Chinese officials and people were excited about this unprecedented change, teams composed of ancient practitioners also arrived at the edge of the Huainan restricted area one after another.

Some of them control flying swords, some ride on ancient Dharma boats, and some even fly directly in the flesh, carrying a primitive atmosphere that is incompatible with modern society.

"Stop! The front is a military restricted area. No one is allowed to enter without permission!"

The soldiers in charge of perimeter security immediately raised their guns nervously and shouted a warning when they saw these people in "fancy clothes."

However, these people from the hidden sect who had just come out of the deep mountains and old forests would never take mortal soldiers seriously.

"How dare a mere mortal block my way? Get away!"

An elder from the Zhongnan Mountain tomb guardian lineage had a hot temper. He just snorted coldly, and an invisible wave of air pushed the soldiers away several meters away.

Although these soldiers have undergone intensive training, they are still not good enough in front of real practitioners.

"You..."

The soldiers wanted to say something, but more streams of light fell from the sky.

The disciples of the Shushan Sword Sect all carry long swords on their backs and have sharp eyes.

The Taoist priest on the abbot's fairy island holds a fly whisk and a fairy-like Taoist bone.

There were also some small sects whose names I couldn’t name, but they also took out their own wardrobe, for fear of being looked down upon.

There were hundreds of them gathered together, and each one exuded a powerful aura.

This power is enough to easily destroy a modern army.

The person in charge of the garrison, a colonel officer, looked at the group of people in front of him who seemed to have walked out of a myth. Cold sweat broke out on his forehead, but he still did not flinch. He only called for emergency help from his superiors through the walkie-talkie.

"Taoist Priest Li Hanshan, Sect Leader Yun Xiao, outside... there is a large group of unidentified practitioners coming outside, and they want to force their way into the restricted area!"

Soon, Li Hanshan, Yun Xiao and others got the news.

They looked at each other and saw the solemn look in each other's eyes.

"Let's go and have a look."

As the head of Kunlun and the first person to swear allegiance to Gu Changqing, Li Hanshan naturally took on the responsibility of "maintaining stability" at this moment.

When Li Hanshan, Yun Xiao and others appeared at the edge of the restricted area, the monks from the hidden sect immediately turned their attention.

"Oh? Finally a few decent ones have arrived."

The elder from Zhongnan Mountain looked Li Hanshan up and down with a hint of contempt in his eyes.

"Look at your clothes, do you think you are from the Kunlun sect? Humph, in the Battle of the Gods, your Kunlun predecessors taught the Twelve Golden Immortals, how majestic they were. How come you have become so weak in your generation? You are not even at the Golden Core stage. It is really embarrassing."

Li Hanshan's face darkened when he heard this.

Although their Kunlun sect is also considered a famous sect, compared with these hidden sects passed down from ancient times, their background is indeed much worse.

Especially when the other party mentioned the Battle of the Gods as soon as he opened his mouth, his old-timer demeanor made him breathless.

"Who is this senior?" Li Hanshan asked patiently, holding up his hands.
